subject.fact_scope: Event-related mobile making activity previously researched; no permanent shop location, catalog, prices or rights inferred
subject.rights_status: AI generated conceptual image only; not merchant authorization

original_image_status.owner_quote: 同じような構成になってきた
original_image_status.problem: The opening resembles other projects despite a metal mobile: top horizontal nav, copy at left, full image with annotations, wavy scene divider, second photo band; changing object or palette did not change the skeleton.

goal: Invent completely different first-screen geometry, information movement and responsive strategy rather than decorate the common image hero and photo section.
protected_constraints: not a template selected by color
no inferred permanent shop address, workshop schedule or product prices
reference image not promoted to success
physical balance, making process and material identity are inspiration, not actual inventory
visible how-to-contact only when source verified
do not imitate CP-015 table/notes interaction
must inspect desktop and mobile wireframes BEFORE image generation

comparison_basis.reason: Other cases lack a standardized common section map. This experiment only compares declared proposal structures, not visual similarity to each past design.

proposals.name: 重さがレイアウトを決める / Counterweight Interface
proposals.core_device: A central balance pivot spans the page; selecting an object changes how small content masses are positioned in the blank canvas, with stable non-moving text alternative.

first_screen.composition: Not a photograph: an almost empty warm-white field with one long horizontal fine line, a single hanging dark disk on one side, and an offset small gold plate on the other; micro labels around the pivot, no left-copy/right-image split.
first_screen.position_of_type: The title and captions are subordinate to the structural device, not a large headline beside a hero photograph

sections.info: The visitor understands the studio premise through one balanced assembly, not a banner
Three distinct scale relationships; user may select a metal shape
The selected piece gains a close-up and verified interpretation
Material and craftsmanship notes, conditional on verified facts
Verified workshop/contact information, otherwise only official social link

proposals.desktop_strategy: A central balance pivot spans the page; selecting an object changes how small content masses are positioned in the blank canvas, with stable non-moving text alternative.
proposals.mobile_strategy: Pivot becomes vertical with two touch-safe choices and a static equivalent; no tiny interactive suspended rods required on phones.
proposals.accessibility: Operable buttons and optional reduced-motion mode; semantic headings; no information exclusive to motion.
no_go: large full-bleed photograph with left headline
proposals.main_risk: Can feel like an art experiment rather than a useful shop site; preserve straightforward contact access.

proposals.name: 影の展示室 / Shadow Gallery
proposals.core_device: Products and their shadows are curated as a sparse asymmetric museum wall, with navigation based on numbered exhibit labels and generous periods of silence.

first_screen.composition: A near-empty wall, one tiny metal mobile at the upper off-center, its disproportionately large shadow reaching the opposite corner; shop name small at bottom edge, numbered exhibit index on perimeter.
first_screen.position_of_type: The title and captions are subordinate to the structural device, not a large headline beside a hero photograph

sections.info: Material and ambient shadow create hierarchy without giant photo
Object close-up and cast shadow shown as independent spatial objects
A few labeled works only if factual inventory confirmed
A nearly blank wall as a breathing pause
Clearly typeset verified access, workshop link, contact

proposals.desktop_strategy: Products and their shadows are curated as a sparse asymmetric museum wall, with navigation based on numbered exhibit labels and generous periods of silence.
proposals.mobile_strategy: Uses tall photographic wall and separate large-tap exhibit labels; shadows remain present without tiny text or hover.
proposals.accessibility: Exhibit names are links/buttons; readable alternative list; visual effects are decorative.
no_go: large full-bleed photograph with left headline
proposals.main_risk: Minimalism may become empty rather than intentional, or generic portfolio gallery; typography and shadow must do real work.

proposals.name: 金属の組立図 / Exploded Assembly Atlas
proposals.core_device: An exploded mechanical assembly drawing becomes the site navigation, where parts, manufacturing steps and dimensions are spatially annotated only with confirmed shop facts.

first_screen.composition: An enormous deconstructed mobile with suspended components at different vertical levels, line-numbered parts and a small technical title block; no hero image and no standard horizontal navbar.
first_screen.position_of_type: The title and captions are subordinate to the structural device, not a large headline beside a hero photograph

sections.info: Parts are separated like an engineering diagram
Explain process only with verified steps; no invented metallurgy
Label samples and textures in an experimental ledger
Still or animated diagram of balance; no invented product functionality
A clear technical footer block with known contact info

proposals.desktop_strategy: An exploded mechanical assembly drawing becomes the site navigation, where parts, manufacturing steps and dimensions are spatially annotated only with confirmed shop facts.
proposals.mobile_strategy: Parts become a single-column numbered sequence; the original exploded composition is preserved as a simplified accessible schematic.
proposals.accessibility: Every part number is focusable; reduced motion support and full text equivalent.
no_go: large full-bleed photograph with left headline
proposals.main_risk: A technical motif may falsely imply manufacture specifications; mark all invented diagrams as concepts and verify statements.

current_recommendation.rationale: Most different from recent editorial/photo-led pages and CP-015's table-navigation; needs whitespace and dynamic counterweight rather than another illustrated index.

no_asset_generation_authorization: No new image, site implementation, official shop endorsement or publishing is implied by this research record.
